status_note: ONE offer, every visitor's (SPEC-save-offer-production.md section 10.7, the Advisor 2026-10-22): the Boston offer, a price promise (code_mode none: no code is issued, shown or needed at the store), its label approved 2026-10-21, applying to any save from any page (applies_to general) and held until its valid_to, 2026-10-29. After that day no offer is offered: the page draws no save step, an offer save is refused (offer_ended), and /o and E1 say the offer has ended. The date is provisional: an extension is this valid_to, released as the page is. Its id keeps its name so saves already made still find it. Dates are calendar dates in America/New_York, inclusive at both ends. At most one general offer is current on any date (test S11b). The status stays placeholder until the switch-on approves the file (section 6 item 3); nothing in it is a placeholder an approved file would refuse. headline (SPEC-ui-and-copy-pass.md section 1 item 1, the Advisor 2026-10-23: 'I'm OK with iterating on it') is the words the offer box at the top of the page prints; label stays what the save step's line and /o print, since 'Today only' would be false in a next-morning email; an offer without headline prints its label in the box. savings_percent (section 1 item 7, the contract's default until the Advisor says what he meant by 'show this all as discounts') is the percentage the offer's words name: while the offer is current, See all plans shows each plan's weekly price struck through with its price after this percentage beside it (the build computes each, rounded to the cent); an offer without it shows the grid as built.
